scope: Counts and pointwise bounds copied from accepted complete audits. Correct-reception confidence does not establish noise-tail or wrong-key qualification.

cells.scope: Conditional only on this fixed simulated cell and its declared iid physical-path/bit-stratum assumptions. Bounds are pointwise and are not pooled across cells or a guarantee for real-world fading or continuous-operation false admissions.

relaxed.balanced_mean_bound_method: mean of per-bit one-sided 97.5% exact binomial lower bounds (Bonferroni pointwise 95%)
